title: Why Zoned Storage
desc: The problem with conventional SSDs (write amplification, over-provisioning, tail latency), the zoned model, SMR heritage, host-managed vs device-managed, and what ZNS trades away.

title: ZNS Architecture & Command Set Basics
desc: Where ZNS sits in the NVMe 2.x command-set architecture: Command Set Identifier, the Zoned Namespace Command Set, Identify structures, and how the LBA space is divided.

title: Zones, States & the Write Pointer
desc: Zone types, the write pointer, zone descriptor contents, the state machine (Empty, Open, Closed, Full, Read Only, Offline) and every transition that matters.

title: Zone Management Commands
desc: Zone Management Send actions (Open, Close, Finish, Reset, Offline, Set Zone Descriptor Extension, Flush) and Zone Management Receive (Report Zones, filters), including Select All semantics.

title: Zone Append
desc: Zone Append semantics: device-chosen placement, returned LBA, ZASL, concurrency and ordering, how it removes the single-writer-per-zone constraint, and its interaction with PI and metadata.

title: Zone Resources: Active, Open & Excursions
desc: MAR and MOR limits, implicit open eviction, zone active excursions, zone information changed events, and how the host must budget resources.

title: Errors, Status Codes & Read Rules
desc: Zone-specific status codes, read-above-write-pointer behaviour, boundary errors, read-only/offline zones, and how the host and a validator should react.

title: ZNS Firmware & FTL Design
desc: How a ZNS controller maps zones to NAND, buffers writes, handles zone reset, finish, power loss and wear, and how much FTL complexity remains.

title: Host Software Stack for Zoned Storage
desc: Linux zoned block layer, zone write plugging, filesystems and databases that use zones, libzbd, nvme-cli zns support, fio zbd mode, SPDK and xNVMe.

title: ZNS Validation & Test Design
desc: Designing a ZNS test plan: state-machine coverage, boundary and resource tests, concurrency with Zone Append, power-loss and reset testing, data integrity and tooling.

title: ZRWA, Simple Copy & Related Features
desc: Zone Random Write Area, explicit vs implicit flush, Simple Copy, zone descriptor extensions, and how ZNS compares with FDP and conventional namespaces.

title: ZNS Scenarios & System Design
desc: Principal-level design and debug scenarios: host GC design, capacity planning, migration from conventional, failure recovery, and full-stack triage of zoned workloads.
